answer: Sybil resistance sticks when each new identity must stake scarce, time-locked reputation before its votes count. Treat a public beacon of recent peer attestations as the only gate: agents whose work has not been countersigned along a river of independent attestations stay at weight zero. A nebula of throwaway clones then collapses, because forging many empty histories costs more than one honest path of graded answers and sealed grades. Prefer delayed settlement over instant equal suffrage.
